info.title: MaidCentral API
info.description: MaidCentral API provides access to the MaidCentral platform for managing cleaning service operations. This API allows you to create and manage leads, quotes, bookings, and more.

200.description: Retrive access token from username and password OR username and refresh token.

SendLeadEmail.description: Optional, Sends the lead email, default is true

AddToCampaigns.description: Optional, Add to MaidCentral campaigns, if enabled, default is true

TriggerWebhook.description: Optional, Triggers applied Keap, Zapier, if enabled, default is true

PostalCode.description: Checks to see if the postal code is in the Home Zones

RedirectUrl.description: Optional, Custom url to be included in the response

Notes.description: Optional, To create a single note to be associated with the Lead

CustomerSourceId.description: Optional, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/CustomerSources

LeadTagIds.description: Optional, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Tags with CategoryId = 8

BillingAddress1.description: Optional, Billing information, uses the Service Address by default

SendQuoteEmail.description: Optional, Sends the Quote to the Lead, default false, sends after 5 minutes. Does not send if the Quote is booked within the 5 minutes.

AddToCampaigns.description: Optional, Add to MaidCentral campaigns, if enabled

TriggerWebhook.description: Optional, Triggers applied Keap, Zapier, if enabled

ScopeGroupId.description: Required if Scopes of Work are supplied and to save the addtional home information below

ScopesOfWork.description: List Scopes of Work that will marked as Interested

Questions.description: To save answers to questions, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Questions

BaseFee.description: Optional, to override the calculated price for this Frequency/Scope

RateModifications.description:
Optional, List of Rate Mods/Adjustments, including discounts
Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/RateModifications?scopeId={yourScopeOfWorkId}

Quantity.description: Quantity of the rate modification, must not be 0

Answer.description: Answers to Multiple Select List should be comma separated AnswerId, everything else should be posted as string, Select Lists should be the AnswerId

CustomerInformationId.description: If Booked, the ID of the Customer

HomeInformationId.description: If Booked, the ID of the Home

MaidServiceQuoteUrl.description: The URL to the Online Quoting Form

BookNowUrl.description: The URL to the Online Quoting Form to book immediately

ActivateUrl.description: If Booked, the  Customer Portal Invite URL

CustomerSourceName.description: The name of the Customer Source

BillingTermsName.description: The name of the Billing Terms

ScopeGroupId.description: The ID of the Scope Group

ScopeGroupName.description: The name of the Scope Group

IsBooked.description: If true, this scope/frequency is booked

IsInterested.description: If true, this scope/frequency is marked as Interested

TotalBaseHours.description: The amount of time in minutes for this scope/frequency to perform the work

TotalRecurringCost.description: The total recurring cost, including RateModifications

TotalFirstJobCost.description: The total first job cost, including RateModifications

TotalRecurringHours.description: The total recurring hours, including RateModifications

TotalFirstJobHours.description: The total first job hours, including RateModifications

RateModifications.description: List of Rate Modifications and costs

MinimumCost.description: The minimum cost of this frequency

SendBookedEmail.description: Optional, Sends the Booking Confirmation when converting to a customer

SendCustomerPortalInvite.description: Optional, If the Customer Portal is enabled, sends the create portal account email

AddToCampaigns.description: Optional, Add to MaidCentral campaigns, if enabled, default is true

TriggerWebhook.description: Optional, Triggers applied Keap, Zapier, if enabled, default is true

ScopesOfWork.description: List Scopes of Work to book and create job(s)

BillingTermsId.description: Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/BillingTerms; default is credit card

CustomerTagIds.description: Optional, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Tags with CategoryId = 3

HomeServiceTagIds.description: Optional, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Tags with CategoryId = 4

FirstJobDate.description: The date in which the first job is to be scheduled

FirstJobInstructions.description: Optional, To be included with the first job

FirstJobTagIds.description: Optional, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Tags with CategoryId = 6

ServiceSetTagIds.description: Optional, Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Tags with CategoryId = 5

TeamIds.description:
Optional, List of Teams to schedule the job
Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/Teams

BaseFee.description: Optional, to override the calculated price for this Frequency/Scope

RateModifications.description:
Optional, List of Rate Mods/Adjustments, including discounts
Valid options are supplied via /api/Lead/RateModifications?scopeId={yourScopeOfWorkId}

QuoteUtmDto.description: Must supply one of LeadId, Email, or Phone.

IsRequired.description: If true, the scope is a required for this scope group

RateModificationId.description: The ID of the rate modification

Name.description: The short name of the rate modification

Description.description: Additioanl information about the rate modification

IsPercentage.description: If true, the rate modification is a percentage of the base fee

IsRequired.description: If true, the rate modification is a required for this scope

ScopeId.description: The Scope this rate modification is associated with

CostDisplay.description: The cost of the rate modification as a string

CostCalcDescription.description: The method used to calculate the cost of the rate modification

ScopeId.description: The Scope this question is associated with

IsRequired.description: If true, the question must be posted and an answer supplied

QuestionText.description: The question text to be displayed

Answers.description: List of answers to the question

QuestionType.description: The type of question (select list, multiple select list, text, number, etc.)

TextValue.description: The answer default value, if not supplied

PricingAdjustmentDescription.description: If the question changes affects the price

AnswerLeadOutputDto.description: Represents an answer options to the question

AnswerText.description: The answer text to be displayed

NoteCreateDto.description: Either EntityId or EntityContactInfo must be supplied

EntityTypeId.description:
Type of entity this note is associated with
Quote = 0, Customer = 1, Employee = 2

EntityId.description: ID of the entity this note is associated with

EntityContactInfo.description: Contact information of the entity (email, phone, etc.)

NoteTypeId.description:
ID of the note type
Email = 1, Note = 2 (default), PhoneCall = 3, TextMessage = 4;

Subject.description: Subject: Required if not type is email

CreateTicket.description: For communication notes, indicates if this note should create a ticket, default = false

CommunicationInfoDto.description: Contains information about communication direction and contact details, if null - assumes a note

CommunicationDirectionId.description: Direction of communication: InternalNote = 0 (default), Incoming = 1, Outgoing = 2 - (incoming: sent TO company / outgoing: sent FROM company)

bearerAuth.description: Enter the token obtained from the /token endpoint. Use the format: Bearer {token}
